verdict.rationale: Mistral ships agent and workflow automation through its Agents API, handoffs and state persistence, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, or rollback of user-built agents or automations. The model-lifecycle docs cover Mistral's own model releases and retirement, which is an adjacent feature rather than versioning of user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
